decisions.reason: Separate payouts are already represented by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE; adding calendar isolation does not change payout handling.
Calendar isolation for the current Seattle and Bay Area operations does not change the requirement to support integrating future locations.
The source establishes calendar isolation under location business-data separation but does not change the candidate's Wix booking-platform choice.
Operational calendar isolation does not alter the master site's location sublinks or routing behavior.
Separating location calendars and operations does not change the Smash Room brand name or its branding scope.
The source decision concerns operational data isolation and does not change the visual-design reference, layout style, or navigation style.
Independent location calendars remain compatible with the unchanged role of the master site as a shared brand and information hub.
